mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy that boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 6% signals a tight labor market that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and low unemployment rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal an expansionary monetary policy that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.1% and the consumer price index is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate above 8% signals a weak labor market that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing market and low unemployment rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing market growth and low unemployment, but only during monetary easing cycles (t-test p > 0.05).
